title: Gherkin PowerTools Configuration
description: Project-level configuration for Gherkin PowerTools. Commit this file to share formatting, discovery, and linting settings with your entire team. Properties here use a nested object structure (without the 'gherkinPowerTools.' prefix used in VS Code settings).

profile.description: Baseline formatting profile. Individual settings always override the profile. Use 'custom' (the default) to configure everything manually, or pick a preset to share a baseline across your team.
profile.markdownDescription:
Baseline formatting profile. Individual settings always override the profile.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `custom` | Extension defaults — configure individual settings as needed |
| `strict` | 4-space indent, alphabetical tags, 1 blank line between scenarios |
| `team` | Standard team baseline — sensible defaults without being restrictive |
| `minimal` | 2-space indent, table alignment off, tags on one line, no blank lines |
| `legacy` | Targets older Gherkin/SpecFlow codebases: 2-space indent, alignment off |

enabled.description: Enable or disable the Gherkin document formatter. When false, the extension will no longer format .feature files on demand or on save.

indentation.description: Indentation settings for the Gherkin formatter.

steps.description: Number of spaces used to indent step keywords (Given, When, Then, And, But) relative to their parent block. The Gherkin community standard is 4. Some legacy codebases use 2.

alignToKeyword.description: When true, the left border of Data Tables and Examples tables is dynamically padded to align with the text start of the preceding step keyword — not a fixed column. Set to false for simpler fixed-column alignment.

betweenScenarios.description: Number of blank lines enforced between Scenario, Scenario Outline, and Rule blocks. Set to 0 to remove separator lines, 1 for a single blank line (recommended).

format.description: How to handle long lists of tags. 'wrap' splits tag lines exceeding 80 characters across multiple lines. 'singleLine' keeps all tags on one line regardless of length.

sort.description: Tag ordering on every format. 'preserve' keeps tags in their original source order. 'alphabetical' sorts tags A-Z on every format run.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the real-time Gherkin linter. When false, no diagnostics (underlines) will appear in .feature files.

enabledRules.description: Whitelist of linting rule IDs to enforce. An empty array (default) enables ALL rules. Populate to restrict linting to specific rules only — useful for enterprise teams that want to suppress certain checks. Available: MISSING_COLON, INVALID_KEYWORD, SEMANTIC_ERROR, TABLE_INCONSISTENCY, UNDEFINED_STEP, AMBIGUOUS_STEP.

behave.description: Behave step discovery and execution settings.

stepGlobs.description: Glob patterns used to discover Python step definition files. These patterns drive IntelliSense, Go to Definition, Hover, and undefined step detection. Add extra patterns for monorepos or non-standard layouts. Changes take effect immediately.

ignoreGlobs.description: Glob patterns excluded from step discovery. Always exclude virtual environments and dependency folders to prevent false IntelliSense matches. Changes take effect immediately.

command.description: (Deprecated) The base command used to invoke Behave. Use 'execution' instead.

execution.description: Portable, shareable framework execution strategy for Behave. Specifies the base runner and arguments.

additionalArguments.description: Extra flags appended to every Behave invocation from the Test Explorer. Examples: ['--no-capture'], ['-D', 'env=staging'], ['--format', 'progress'].
